svg.title: Uber data engineering architecture — Event Hub direct to Bronze via Spark Streaming
svg.desc: Web app produces events to Azure Event Hubs, which feeds directly into Bronze via Spark Structured Streaming. GitHub supplies mapping tables and initial load to ADF and Databricks. Databricks processes through metadata-driven streaming, SCD, and STAR schema into Gold zone.
